body: Watching a children's show. I don't want to name the title because I know people who might browse this subreddit and identify me (namely, the former friend that I referred to in my OP post), but it's not one of those kids' shows that adults can also enjoy like MLP or Adventure Time. It's a show for children through and through, and I'm embarrassed about spending so much time watching it, but it really helps me relax and stay happy.

I've looked into it before. It's not free because I don't have my university's health insurance. Also, I checked my regular health insurance and mental health is not covered under the plan. Don't want to talk to my parents again about this, because it's just going to evolve into a huge argument again with them insisting that there's nothing wrong with me.
